summary: Round 22 extra-levers scan for 29 Sep (written ~01:25Z 28 Sep, before any W1 read). I re-ran the exp60 insertion lab (56 clips, in-sample 5-fold DaughterNet; cap-4 parity exact at 0.939878) with 14 arms over DIVINS_ALPHA, frame cap on cap 6 and steal cap. Result: nothing reaches R8, and nothing earns a pre-built rung. (1) cap 6 + FRAME_CAP 2 is the only lever that differs structurally from 'more cap'. It re-ranks at equal volume (289 vs 286 insertions): 26/56 clips change, 30 in / 27 out, net -1 evaluable FP. Lab gain vs cap 6 is +0.0002 (bootstrap CI90 -0.0002..+0.0008; 44b6 0). Its public prior is weak (E ~+0.0001, P(display >= 0.957) ~0.2). It is a knob rung, which v2 (6) and W4 AMEND 2 (4) ban in W3/W4. exp78b (cap 12 + fc2) already carries fc2, so it adds no decision value. (2) DIVINS_ALPHA: 0.5 is an exact lab null at cap 6 (52 swaps, 0 net evaluable). alpha 0 is extra volume in disguise (eligible x3.8, +44 insertions) with adj edge -0.00016. alpha 2/3 is refuted in the lab (-0.0017/-0.0022; it drops 3-4 TPs, including the only 44b6 TP). (3) DaughterNet fold-subset ensembles cannot be replayed from the dumps, which hold only the ensemble p. Fewer folds give more extreme p (r9h-4: 99th pct 0.90 vs 0.83), which again means more volume above thr 0.4, plus noise. It has no gate. A smaller steal cap (sf 0.34) is null (-0.00007). Steal off stays closed (-0.002). Runtime is ~0 h for every arm: selection happens after DaughterNet scoring. Recommendation: keep W2 TABLE v4 / W4 AMEND 2 as written. Build nothing. The cap direction reads (47 exp78b, 49 exp78a) already span every structural insertion lever we have.
